item.title: Sustainable Energy Solutions for Low-Carbon and Smart Mobility
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on sustainable energy approaches and technologies that enable low-carbon and intelligent mobility systems. The collection seeks to advance understanding of how energy solutions can reduce transportation emissions while supporting smart mobility innovations and infrastructure development.

Appel publié par Transport Policy. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Low-carbon transport
  • Smart mobility
  • Sustainable energy solutions
  • Electric vehicles
  • Public transportation
  • Alternative fuels
  • Mobility infrastructure

item.title: Multicriteria Decision Aiding for Sustainable Energy and Environmental Planning
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites research on the application of multicriteria decision aiding methods to address complex challenges in sustainable energy and environmental planning. The work seeks contributions that demonstrate how decision support techniques can inform policy and strategic planning in these critical areas.

Appel publié par Socio-Economic Planning Sciences. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Timeline

  • January 31, 2027: Full paper submission deadline
